draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Varca! The row of wooden fishing boats you see lined up on its beach belongs to the local Christian fishing community.
draft.hungryLine: With the fishing boats pulled up right on the beach, this is a place for fresh fish.

moodReplies.show-me-around: Varca Church is a 2 min walk, and Our Lady of Piety is about 17 min away.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Walk down to the beach Varca is known for and watch the wooden fishing boats.
moodReplies.surprise-me: Most men in Varca work as seafarers or in the Gulf, especially Kuwait, the UAE and Bahrain.

spots.name: Varca Church
spots.detail: 2 min walk · Our Lady of Gloria, one of the oldest buildings in Varca

spots.name: Our Lady of Piety
spots.detail: 17 min walk · Another place of worship in the village

tips.title: Dress modestly at church.
tips.body: Our Lady of Gloria is still in use, with locals and visitors attending its services.

tips.title: Visit Ashvek Vintage World.
tips.body: At Nuvem in Salcete, this collection restores and keeps old cars like Mercedes Benz, Peugeot, Morris and Volkswagen.

story.title: Orlim's converts
story.body: The people of nearby Orlim, made up of five clans of the Chardos, were the first of their caste in Salcete to convert to Christianity.

story.title: Our Lady of Gloria
story.body: The Our Lady of Gloria church is considered one of the oldest buildings in Varca. St Mary's High School next to it is run by the church.

story.title: A small town
story.body: The 2001 census counted 4,859 people in Varca, mostly Catholics and Hindus.

story.title: Seafarers and fishers
story.body: The population is now about 25,000. Many men work at sea or in the Gulf, while the fishing boats still line the beach.
